draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.66, the 249th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 19th of 19 at LB. He went 143rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (249th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 76 tackles in 2023, 13th of 19 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons (reserve). 27 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 off-ball linebacker who played: 35 combined tackles against a median of 35 (level with).
